title: Decoder, guide and internal playback repair
notes: OpenTV now falls back when a device's preferred hardware decoder fails, directly repairs a blank bundled guide using the current on-device XMLTV data, automatically downloads future signed updates and opens Android's install confirmation, and plays genuine HTTP/HLS/DASH/YouTube add-on results internally instead of launching another app. Existing channels, favourites, settings, add-ons and logins are preserved.
